notes: Puzzle rating now works exactly like Lichess: a wrong move, or a hint after you have already moved, costs rating straight away. A hint before your first move only makes the puzzle unrated.
New: rating milestones. The first time your puzzle rating reaches a new hundred, that puzzle is saved in Achievements so you can replay it.
Pieces lift and wiggle while you hold them with the mouse, on every freeChess.com board and in analysis.
